message: No detected input validation: The code reads the CSV directly with pd.read_csv and passes data through without any schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from a local file path only; there is no remote source fetching, so no checksum verification or authentication mechanisms are present or needed—but the control is absent.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no validation of label values against an expected set, no distribution comparison, and no label-noise detection tool used anywhere in the pipeline.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs is performed on the training data before or during preparation.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads the serialized model using joblib.load() without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision; there is no integrity verification before deserialization.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label set, or anomalous sample distribution before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: The model is trained with a standard scikit-learn RandomForestClassifier with no differential privacy mechanisms applied.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the evaluation pipeline.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although a train/test split is performed, there is no signed/hashed evaluation data, no isolation enforcement beyond the split, and no independent secondary evaluation mechanism to protect against metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: The online_inference function directly processes row_dict values without any shape, range, type, or schema validation before encoding and passing to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: The inference function returns raw model predictions without any NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validation before returning results.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a tabular classification model (RandomForestClassifier), not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
